court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
judges: To Constitute A Larger Bench J.
case_name: Km. Rachna And Another v. State Of U P And 4 Others

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and 4 others (husband, husband's family)

facts_of_case: First information report lodged by mother of second petitioner Km. Anchal; illegal detention in Children Home (Girl) District Saharanpur

legal_principles.principle: A judicial order passed by the Child Welfare Committee is appealable and hence, the Habeas Corpus Petition is not maintainable.
legal_principles.held: The order passed by the Committee is a judicial order and hence, the detention of corpus cannot be termed to be illegal. Moreover, the order passed by the Committee is appealable and hence the Habeas Corpus Petition is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed.
cited_cases: Smt. Neelam vs. State of UP & 4 others, (Year) X SCC Y
Rahul Kumar Singh & another vs. State of UP 19 and Kajal & another vs. State of UP and ors, (Year) X SCC Y
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — highlights the importance of considering appealability in judicial orders

legal_principles.principle: The court must ensure that a person whose production is sought is not illegally detained.
legal_principles.held: The Court while dealing with habeas corpus petitions are required to ensure that the person whose production is sought is not illegally detained.
legal_principles.significance: MEDIUM — emphasizes the importance of due process in detention matters

outcome.final_order: Release corpus/2nd petitioner Km. Anchal from illegal detention

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for habeas corpus
